purpose: Collect sanitized read-only REG.RU prerequisites for a separate TAI service without mutating Compose, PostgreSQL or production workloads.
requiredBehavior: accept only exact current main and its canonical TAI image
verify the image revision on the runner and REG.RU host
discover protected production Compose and network authority without changing it
recover the running private Qwen credential without disclosure
execute PostgreSQL evidence collection in an explicit read-only transaction
verify required relations, SELECT privileges, knowledge chunks and model admission
perform one authenticated deterministic Qwen probe
publish only sanitized counts, statuses and reason codes to issue 3553
forbiddenCapabilities: docker compose up, down, restart or recreate
credential, DSN, endpoint, model identity or model output disclosure
tenant, role, model-admission, financial, veterinary or write-authority expansion
